summary: Phase 149O.1H -- HATP Proof Models + Canonical Serialization Independent Verification: independent adversarial re-verification of Wave 3 (src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py). Status: completed. Completeness: exact production diff independently reconstructed from git show 01c7fb74 (confirmed exactly one new src/pcae/ file); HATP-REQ-067..077 and HATP-REQ-117 independently re-derived by reading HATP-001 directly (not the 149O.1D plan's table); full model field inventory, AG3/AG5 discriminator behavior, constructor/parser-domain comparison, immutability analysis, closed-schema attack matrix, duplicate-key attack, Unicode analysis, timestamp semantics/injectivity, signed-payload reconstruction, golden-vector independent derivation, digest verification, mutation matrix, and purity/dependency audit all independently performed. F-149O.1C-1 verdict: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED IMPLEMENTED -- STRICT CLOSED PROOF SEMANTICS ENFORCED (at the parser boundary: all 13 self-selected-trust/authority-boolean field names tested rejected; AG3/AG5 wrong-family fields rejected; duplicate JSON keys rejected at every tested position). Two BLOCKING findings discovered, reproduced, and NOT repaired per this phase's verification-only mandate: B-149O.1H-1 -- the canonical timestamp renderer (_canonical_timestamp_string) truncates via strftime('%f')[:-3] rather than rounding, so two individually-ISO-8601-valid, individually-accepted issued_at instants that differ only in sub-millisecond precision (2026-01-01T12:00:00.0001Z vs 2026-01-01T12:00:00.0009Z, 800 microseconds apart) both canonicalize to identical bytes and an identical SHA-256 digest -- canonicalization is not injective over the accepted semantic domain, violating HATP-REQ-075's determinism requirement. B-149O.1H-2 -- HumanApprovalProvenanceProof.__post_init__ (and the two operation-reference dataclasses) enforce only the AG3/AG5 family-vs-operation-reference-type check; every other structural invariant enforced by parse_hatp_proof (repository-ID UUID4 format, SHA-256 digest format, commit-SHA format, proof_version membership including the explicit bool-guard, non-empty identifiers, timestamp parseability/canonicality) is absent from the public dataclass constructors, so direct construction -- an ordinary, legitimate library-API call that a future Wave 4/5 provider adapter would necessarily use -- silently accepts and canonicalizes/digests structurally-invalid proofs the parser would reject, including a proof_version=True boolean that serializes as JSON true instead of an integer. One non-blocking finding: repository_id accepts uppercase UUID4 strings (via is_valid_repository_instance_id's str(parsed)==value.lower() comparison) but does not normalize them to the canonical lowercase form used consistently by decision_record_digest/binding_digest/original_commit_sha, so a case-variant of the same UUID canonicalizes to different bytes. Several non-blocking observations also recorded: whitespace-only/padded opaque identifiers accepted and retained verbatim (defensible, not a violation); datetime.fromisoformat's acceptance of colonless UTC offsets and non-standard fractional-digit counts is a Python >=3.11 behavior not exercised by this repo's CI despite a declared >=3.9 floor; no domain-separation tag distinguishes HATP canonical bytes from other project artifacts' canonical bytes at the raw-byte level (not required by HATP-001); a lone UTF-16 surrogate is rejected only at canonicalization time (UnicodeEncodeError), not at parse time. Files changed: 1 new independent verification doc (docs/PHASE_149O_1H_HATP_PROOF_MODELS_CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md), 1 new independent test file (tests/test_phase_149o_1h_hatp_proof_models_canonical_serialization_independent_verification.py, 166 tests), PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plus task-lifecycle files. Zero production code touched: git diff --name-only 84cb9b15..HEAD -- src/pcae/ is empty. Zero contract text touched: git diff --name-only 84cb9b15..HEAD -- docs/contracts/ is empty. repository_identity.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py all confirmed byte-unchanged since 01c7fb74 (also asserted as a permanent regression test in the new test file). No new production dependency added to pyproject.toml. Golden vectors: independently derived (not copied from the 149O.1G test files) using a hand-written canonicalizer separate from canonicalize_hatp_proof_payload; both AG3 and AG5 vectors matched the implementation's actual output exactly (AG3 digest d69567a62527f37825bc59fcb0564f21281511c21ffb0a07195c21dc8ff84212, AG5 digest 9efedce2594fcd123f4646c88278f8820eb274ea45d06afd9a9cbd3e5c845312), confirming the serializer itself is correct for the tested inputs -- the BLOCKING findings are about the accepted-input domain (timestamps) and the constructor domain, not about the serializer's arithmetic. Mutation-sensitivity matrix: every AG3 field and every AG5-specific field, individually mutated, changes the digest (confirmed independently), except the sub-millisecond timestamp probe (B-149O.1H-1). AG3/AG5 collision test: proofs constructed with deliberately identical opaque values across every shared and family-specific field still canonicalize to different bytes (rollback_site plus differing key names guarantee no collision by construction). Regressions run and reported exactly: Wave-3 implementation suite (test_hatp_proof_models.py + test_hatp_canonical_serialization.py + test_phase_149o_1g_...py) 100 passed; Wave-1/2 foundation (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py + test_phase_149o_1e_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_1_...py) 103 passed; 149O.1F.2 independent re-verification suite 90 passed; HATP contract+plan regression (149O.1C + 149O.1D suites) 127 passed; broadened RAE/Permission-Broker/agent regression (-k 'rae or permission_broker or rollback_approval or agent or mutation_permission' -n auto) 5 failed / 5631 passed, the same 5 pre-existing failures already documented by 149O.1G (test_149o_fake_chgr_record_plus_fake_publication_receipt, test_149o_fake_binding_plus_fake_creation_registration, test_149o_full_end_to_end_forgery_zero_legitimate_api_calls, test_149o_copied_registration_under_new_key_with_matching_fields_rejected, test_permission_broker_consumer_scope_inventory), not attributable to this phase since no src/pcae/ file changed; Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto -q) 4531 passed, identical to the entering baseline, no regression, new verification tests intentionally not added to Fast Green since they are verification-only and not durable product-level coverage; new independent verification suite itself 166 passed (including the two tests that assert the current, defective BLOCKING behavior as documented, per record-reproduce-do-not-repair convention). Full whole-repository suite not re-run in full this phase (verification-only, zero production files changed, targeted suites above plus the broad RAE/PB/agent regression are sufficient to establish no regression was introduced). Overall Wave-3 verification verdict: NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING HATP WAVE 3 FINDINGS. HATP PRODUCTION: NOT READY (unaffected by this phase's verdict either way -- Wave 4/5/6/7 remain entirely unimplemented). B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, unaffected. F-149O.1C-2 remains editorial debt only. HATP-001 v1.0 remains byte-unchanged. Recommended next phase: 149O.1H.1 -- a narrow repair phase scoped to exactly the two BLOCKING findings (timestamp-canonicalization injectivity and constructor/parser invariant-domain unification) -- Wave 4 (HATP Verification Engine Implementation) should not begin until both are resolved. See docs/PHASE_149O_1H_HATP_PROOF_MODELS_CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
